about: Item structures: where a piece of planted work sits relative to the agent. A stop's intended scope (stops.json) and every scenario item (scenarios/) name structures from this list, so a spelling mistake cannot silently move work out of scope.

structures.agent-main: the agent's own main process, which the run started
structures.agent-child: a process the agent started that stays in its process tree and process group
structures.agent-detached: a process the agent started that left its process tree (new session, parent exited) but stays in the agent's control group
structures.account-service-process: a process that the agent account's own service manager runs (a user service)
structures.account-trigger: a unit, timer, crontab line or at job of the agent account that can start work later
structures.holder-job: a job the agent handed to another program, which runs it under that program's own account
structures.credential: a credential, session or grant issued for the run
structures.network-path: a network path the run's work uses
structures.server-request: a request in progress inside an MCP server's process
structures.server-child: a process that an MCP server's request handler started
structures.platform-component: a long-running process of the platform under test (a main process, a server, a gateway), run as the agent account
structures.platform-worker: a platform's worker process, which runs the work it takes from a queue or a task list, run as the agent account
structures.platform-execution: a unit of work the platform runs for the agent inside one of its components: an n8n execution, a LangGraph run, a Temporal activity, an agent session's turn
structures.platform-child-execution: work the platform runs as an item of its own that another execution started: an n8n sub-workflow execution, a Temporal child workflow
structures.platform-trigger: a schedule or trigger the platform holds, which starts work later without the agent: an n8n schedule trigger, a LangGraph cron, a Temporal timer, an agent gateway's cron
structures.platform-queued: work the platform holds to run again by itself: a run re-queued for the next start, an activity waiting for its retry
structures.tool-background: a command an agent's tool runs as a background task that the agent itself keeps track of (Claude Code's background tasks, OpenClaw's background exec sessions)
